E38.statement: The reduced profile, edit identity, factor bound, and odd state-height bound are independently checked on the complete q<=8 positive-D cyclic exponent corpus.

H133.statement: Critical area at least six, enormous noncritical area, and all noncoprime profiles still require a complete cycle exclusion.

H147.statement: Critical coprime area-three positive cycles are excluded, now as a consequence of the stronger arbitrary-slope P158 barrier.

NG35.statement: The Phase 26 EXT05/factor-separation scalar mechanism can also exclude critical area six.

P156.statement: Every primitive positive-cycle exponent word has the reduced-slope time profile, exact adjacent-swap area, cyclic factor bound, and triangular height bound.

P157.statement: Every primitive positive nontrivial cycle obeys the arbitrary-slope state-height and master factor-separation inequalities.

P158.statement: Every critical primitive positive nontrivial cycle has reduced-slope area A_*>=6.

P159.statement: Every noncritical primitive positive nontrivial cycle has reduced-slope area A_*>100000.

P160.statement: Assuming X02, every noncritical primitive positive cycle has A_*>5*10^15.

P161.statement: Every noncritical cycle with A_*>0 obeys the exact slope/area phase inequality.

reduced_profile.baseline: E_j^(0)=(L0*j+r_j)/q0; its exponent period q0 repeats d times
reduced_profile.edit: A_*=sum_(j<q)a_j is the exact number of adjacent swaps 10->01

what_this_result_does_not_prove: It does not exclude critical area six or above, arbitrary-area positive cycles, any nonperiodic branch, or Collatz.
